# @trysac/idempotency-keys

> Idempotency-Key middleware for Node HTTP servers following draft-ietf-httpapi-idempotency-key-header: key parsing, request fingerprinting, response replay, in-flight locking and pluggable storage. TypeScript library for Node.js 20+, published as ES modules with type declarations. No runtime dependencies. MIT.
